title: ErrorMessage
description: Terminal error reply. id echoes the request id, or is null when the request could not be read. code is listed in protocol/codes.json. For listFolder and showInFolder (about the item's folder): folderNotFound (missing, not a folder, relative or invalid path), accessDenied, or folderUnavailable (any other OS error: drive not ready, share unreachable); when the folder exists but can't be listed, data carries its place as folderListing words it: path, parent and segments.
